name: net_restarted_game_seat_not_held
description: A game started again asks back a seat that is not held any more: client 2 left its match (LEAVE_MATCH, which gives up its note in user://net.cfg), and a note from an earlier match (match 7, left by a crash) is all user:// has. Its first HELLO is a resume naming match 7's wire seat 1; the sequencer answers NOTICE no_held_seat after WELCOME. The game forgets the note and says HELLO again on a new link as a newcomer, waiting for a match like any game; the match the others play goes on.

steps.msg: leaving the match gives the note up
a note from an earlier match, left by a crash
started again, it asks match 7's seat back

steps.eval: scene.run_until('seq.no_held_seat == 1 and client(2).phase_name() == "WAITING" and not client(2).boot_resume', 600)

steps.assert: afresh and scene.client(2).resumes == 1 and scene.client(2).held_match == 0 and scene.client(2).held_seat == 255
steps.msg: NOTICE no_held_seat: one resume HELLO, then the note is forgotten and it waits as a newcomer

steps.assert: scene.client(2).notices.has([9, 0]) and scene.client(2).sim == null and scene.client(2).error_code == 0
steps.msg: it was told so, built no match and was refused nothing
the others play on, the left seat the caretaker's
